Starting Balances — Customers

The Starting Balances - Customers screen allows you to set up starting balances for the customers you have created under the Customers tab. These starting balances represent the amounts that customers owe you at the beginning of your accounting period.

To create a new starting balance for a customer, click the New Starting Balance button.

CustomersNewStartingBalance

You will be taken to the Starting Balance screen for the customer. Here, you can enter the details of the outstanding amounts. See Starting Balance - Customer Form for more information on how to complete this form.
